name: lsp-bridge
description: Polyglot LSP MCP bridge — real type diagnostics instead of LLM guessing (Antipattern #8 prevention)

tools.name: diagnostics
tools.description: Get LSP diagnostics (errors, warnings, hints) for a file. Replaces 'does this compile?' guessing.

tools.name: definition
tools.description: Go-to-definition for a symbol at line:col. Returns target file + range.

tools.name: references
tools.description: Find all references of a symbol at line:col.

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Get type/docstring hover info for a symbol at line:col.

tools.name: workspace_symbols
tools.description: Search symbols across the workspace by name pattern.

tools.name: rename
tools.description: Safe rename of a symbol across the workspace (LSP rename, not regex).
